sentences.span: Moving away from benign de-escalation... incorporate features of a higher oil risk-premium into the baseline... Baseline: Oil Risk Premium/Sticky Inflation (45%)
sentences.why: MS explicitly shifts its US baseline from a benign Middle East de-escalation assumption to an oil risk-premium baseline, and Exhibit 31 gives that baseline a 45% probability.

sentences.span: The latest spot prices, as of September 15, were $107.02 per barrel for WTI in Cushing, Oklahoma, and $130.80 per barrel for Brent... SPR continued to fall to around 285 million barrels, the lowest level since April 1984
sentences.why: All three figures (WTI, Brent, SPR level/date) match the source exactly.

sentences.span: Brent crude oil prices were down -0.71% on the week (-0.91% Friday), closing at $103.87/bbl... Brent is -2.21% lower at $101.65/bbl
sentences.why: Both DB figures are correct and correctly attributed; the sentence's function (two different Brent marks give different pictures) matches the source's own two data points, even though the clause order compresses the timeline.

sentences.span: Once again if looking just at the S&P 500, you would think the surge in energy prices and rates has had little impact... Yet under the surface, NYSE downside volume as a percentage of total volume (20 DMA) has surged back to 54%
sentences.why: Directly restates BTIG's own framing that the index hides deteriorating internals.

sentences.span: S&P 500 EPS grew 51% y/y in Q2... the forward P/E has fallen from ~23x a year ago to ~19x today... GS's 12-month S&P target of 8,700
sentences.why: All figures (51% EPS growth, 23x to 19x multiple, 8,700 target) and the valuation-not-breadth framing match Goldman's text verbatim.

sentences.span: a puzzling and frustrating grind to a sub 15 VIX
sentences.why: The only Goldman VIX reference across the day's sources says 'sub 15,' with no exact level and no Friday-close framing; 'closed Friday at 14' asserts a precision the source doesn't give.

sentences.span: The identified mispriced risk is contagion: the order is explicitly positioned by its sponsors as a national model, with Virginia and Texas identified as the markets where adoption... would have the most material impact
sentences.why: Matches RBC's own framing ('national model' vs 'national template' is a faithful paraphrase); 'sponsors' pitching it as a template is directly stated.

sentences.span: the Top 20% holds $49.8tn in equity wealth against just $8.3tn in labor income... The Top 10% by wealth owns 87% of corporate equities and mutual funds
sentences.why: Both figures match; 'wages' for 'labor income' and 'corporate equities' (dropping 'and mutual funds') are faithful compressions, not distortions.

sentences.span: weaker growth and higher interest costs mean the budget gap will swell to 5.4% of economic output this year, while the finance law had targeted a slight reduction to 5%
sentences.why: Figures and causal framing (budget arithmetic, not a surprise) match exactly.

sentences.span: Scope downgraded France after hours, and DBRS put them on negative watch... Japanese life insurers are now actively selling their exposure to French fixed income markets
sentences.why: Both the ratings action and the Japanese life-insurer selling are stated directly in the source.

sentences.span: Socgen put out a piece saying OAT/bund might go to 120
sentences.why: Matches 'one published estimate' of a 120bp France-Germany spread widening.

sentences.span: The big structural story remains intact: central banks are buying at more than 5x the pre-2022 pace
sentences.why: Matches 'official buying... more than five times the pre-2022 pace' as the floor under gold.

sentences.span: JP Morgan yesterday said that Bitcoin could outperform gold if ETF hedging eases, and predicted Bitcoin ETFs will eventually triple gold in assets
sentences.why: Directly matches the outperformance-if-hedging-eases and triple-gold-ETF-assets claims.

sentences.span: Support has broken the 155 level solidly (closing at 156.9) [Academy Securities] / the Japanese Yen weakened -2.08% against the US Dollar last week, which marked its biggest weekly decline since October 2025 [Deutsche Bank]
sentences.why: The 155/156.9 figures are Academy Securities' (Tchir); the -2.08%/worst-week-since-October-2025 figures are Deutsche Bank's (Reid). The sentence merges both banks' data under a single 'per Academy Securities' attribution — a bank's view/data is misattributed as another's.

sentences.span: Maintain long USD/JPY at 156.23 with a target of 163.00 and a stop of 150.00
sentences.why: 150.00 is exactly Morgan Stanley's stated stop level on its long USD/JPY trade idea; the figure and its role as the trade's invalidation level are accurate.
